nodes.summary: The columns `j` that maximise `(xᵀB)ⱼ = ∑ᵢ xᵢ Bᵢⱼ` against the mixed strategy `x` of player 1.
nodes.title: Pure best responses of player 2

nodes.summary: The rows `i` that maximise `(Ay)ᵢ = ∑ⱼ Aᵢⱼ yⱼ` against the mixed strategy `y` of player 2.
nodes.title: Pure best responses of player 1

nodes.summary: The expected value `xᵀCy = ∑ᵢ ∑ⱼ xᵢ Cᵢⱼ yⱼ` of the payoff matrix `C` when player 1 plays the mixed strategy `x` and player 2 independently plays `y` (von Stengel, *Algorithmic Game Theory*, Section 3.2).
nodes.title: Expected payoffs in a bimatrix game

nodes.summary: The mixed pair `(x, y)` is a Nash equilibrium of the game `(A, B)` if `x` maximises player 1's expected payoff `x'ᵀAy` against `y` and `y` maximises player 2's expected payoff `xᵀBy'` against `x` (von Stengel, *Algorithmic Game Theory*, Section 3.2).
nodes.title: Nash equilibrium of a bimatrix game

nodes.summary: No mixed strategy with support of size `k` has more than `k` pure best responses, for either player (von Stengel, *Algorithmic Game Theory*, Definition 3.2).
nodes.title: Nondegenerate bimatrix game

nodes.summary: If both players have at least one pure strategy and the game `(A, B)` is nondegenerate, then the set of Nash equilibria `(x, y)` is finite and has odd cardinality. (`Set.ncard` of an infinite set is `0`, so oddness of `ncard` includes finiteness.)
nodes.title: A nondegenerate bimatrix game has an odd number of Nash equilibria

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
